{{Quote|This ''is'' it! Or was, an age ago. Don't you see, Slick? Kiirium is artificial shielding material, not very good by modern standards but a major breakthrough in its time, and tough to produce to boot.|Badure|<ref name="HSLL" />}}
'''Kiirium''' was an artificial shielding material whose creation was a major breakthrough around the time of the [[Xim Wars]].<ref name="HSLL" /> One of the materials base components was a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] called [[kiiral]].<ref name="PoG3">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref> Difficult to manufacture, the material could be used to shield heavy guns and [[Engine/Legends|engines]], allowing [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] to field [[Warship/Legends|warships]] that were better armed and faster than almost anything else that his opponents could field.<ref name="HSLL" /> Xim covered his [[war-robot]]s with a [[Laser/Legends|laser]]-reflective kiirium sheen, which gave the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] the ability to deflect laser blasts.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

Xim obtained vast quantities of the metal for his growing war machine, and loaded the treasure ship [[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|''Queen of Ranroon'']] with kiirium, [[Mytag crystal/Legends|mytag crystals]], and [[Bordhell-type fuel slug]]s to hoard in [[Treasure Vaults of Xim the Despot|his vaults]] on [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]]. At that time, these materials represented the pinnacle of military technology and were extremely valuable. Although the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] successfully delivered its load, legends arose that it vanished with the treasure aboard, inspiring generations of treasure hunters to search for the lost ship and its reputed wealth.<ref name="HSLL" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], kiirium's had been greatly devalued and it was ubiquitous through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1BBY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was among an expedition that discovered the fabled treasure of Xim consisted of a stockpile of outdated war supplies, now worthless due to advances in technology.<ref name="HSLL" />
